text: The homotopy hypothesis (Grothendieck, 1983) conjectures that the ∞-category of:
choices: n-categories is equivalent to the ∞-category of n-manifolds
weak ∞-groupoids is equivalent to the ∞-category of spaces (CW complexes) up to homotopy
simplicial sets is equivalent to topological spaces
Kan complexes is equivalent to strict ∞-groupoids
explanation: Homotopy hypothesis: Spaces ≃ ∞-Gpd. HoTT realises this synthetically: types ARE ∞-groupoids. Lurie's work (Higher Topos Theory) gives a rigorous version using quasi-categories.
